Subject: Atlas Integrations + Redwood — joint marketplace demo slot consolidation

Hi Daniel, Liam —

Thanks for the sync last week. PacificSoft (the prospect) confirmed interest in a joint marketplace demo that shows the Redwood inference listing + Atlas Integrations’ SI value prop. We want a single consolidated session (customer-facing) rather than multiple handoffs.

Proposed windows (APAC-friendly):
- Tue Mar 13: 09:00–10:00 SGT / 00:00–01:00 UTC
- Wed Mar 15: 14:00–15:00 SGT / 07:00–08:00 UTC
- Thu Mar 16: 09:00–10:00 SGT / 02:00–03:00 UTC

Please confirm which of the above works for Atlas and AWS, and who will own the technical deep-dive (SI host + Redwood tech host). Attaching the initial runbook (joint-demo-runbook-v1.pdf) — this is a draft.

Also: can Atlas share the preferred invite timezone (SGT/IST/etc.) and whether the SI requires a pre-demo dry run?

Goal: lock a single 60-min slot and add a 30-min pre-call for tech validation if needed.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: joint-demo-runbook-v1.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)

Priya —

Thanks for pulling this together. Atlas is keen — PacificSoft is an important APAC target for us. Quick heads-up: our SI lead (Naomi) is booked for a customer rehearsal on Wed Mar 15 afternoon SGT, so the Mar 15 window may not work.

Alternatives that look open on our side:
- Thu Mar 16 at 09:00 SGT (preferred)
- Fri Mar 17 at 02:00 SGT (late, but open if customer asks for non-business hours)

Naomi will be the SI host for the session (naomi.patel@atlas-integrations.com). We can also provide an .ics for attendees if you want (attached: atlas-ics.ics).

—Daniel
